reviewer: Codex parent plus two read-only AI reviewers
notice: 固定提交的 FastAPI 官方中文资料，AI 在运行前拟定并冻结的新挑战题；未用于此前调参，不是独立人工标注、真实用户评测或可证明未进入模型预训练的盲测。

criteria.correct: Directly responsive and no false facts; correct partial answers may be incomplete.
criteria.complete: All mandatory facts are expressed, including semantic equivalents; citation contents alone do not count as answer text.
criteria.supported: Every claim must be supported by its own attached citations, not a different claim citation.
criteria.strict_pass: Answerable: real model answer and all three semantic checks. Unanswerable: no_evidence and empty claims.
criteria.semantic_refusal: Answer text states the requested facts are unavailable, without supplying an invented answer; can disagree with response status.

judgment_limits: AI judgments, not independent human double annotation.
Extra causal claims and implied wording admit interpretation; per-case notes expose the decisions.
FA03 single-process pre-start migration is accepted as the one-time prior step in context.
FA07 library conversion, FA09 cached first-only creation, FA12 merged non-independent objects are accepted as semantic equivalents.
No annotations, source text or application behavior were revised after the first run.
